claims.statement: Neural candidate-ordering plugin combines queryGCN and node-ID Transformer without neural pruning.
Exactness preservation requires sound complete base algorithm, order-robust safe pruning and full candidate permutations.
Headline98.2% is denseWikiCS across-baseline average medianFMS reduction; timed throughput results use distinct one-second protocol.
Specialist constructive search component uses graph-specific node vocabularies and pergraph training; reorders partial-map expansion, not complete incumbent neural edits.
Search-tree size remains essentially unchanged; finite randomwalk anchor sampling does not exhaust all structural motifs, and batch-amortized latency is not total query time.
